name: Loggerhead
bio: Archetype: Debuff, Healing. ⌽ Has multiple ways to randomly apply [Neg Stats] (such as [Poison], [Burn] and [Petrify]). ⌽ S2 applies [Memory Replay] on some allies (number of allies affected increases with rank). When attacked while under this status, reduce damage taken and inflict random [Neg Stats] on the attacker. ⌽ Heals all allies with [Memory Replay] at turn end. ⌽ Heal rate increases for two turns when allies apply [Neg Stats] on enemies via skills or [Memory Replay]. ⌽ S1 and Ult deal damage and inflict several random [Neg Stats] on enemies.
